overview: Voidstone Corridors form the primary interior passageways of the Akheva Ruins.
details: Alien stone infused with void resonance creates humming conduits and temporal flickers. Sentinels patrol these corridors relentlessly.
hooks: A resonance conduit overloads, destabilizing nearby corridors.
Temporal flickers reveal glimpses of ancient Akhevan rituals.
Sentinel patrols intensify without known cause.
A voidborn swarm breaches a corridor wall.
